title: Monorepo Architecture
definition: A Monorepo is a single Git repository containing multiple distinct projects (e.g., frontend, backend, shared UI library) with well-defined relationships. Tools like Nx or Turborepo manage dependencies and heavily cache builds.
simpleExplanation: Putting all your company's code into one giant folder so that when you update a button color, you instantly see it update in both the customer app and the admin app.

answers.question: What is the main tradeoff of Monorepos?
answers.answer: Usually a tradeoff between Server CPU usage, TTFB (Time to First Byte), and Client CPU usage.
